chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) who said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us who said: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar, from Jabir ibn Yazid al-Ja'fi, from Abu al-Zubayr al-Makki, from Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:

I swear by Him in Whose Hand is my soul, whenever I sent Ali to a military expedition, I would look at Gabriel (peace be upon him) with seventy thousand angels on his right, and Michael on his left with seventy thousand angels, and the Angel of Death in front of him, and a cloud shading him until he was granted good victory.

key_terms.سَرِيَّة: Military expedition led by a companion of the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What divine signs accompanied Imam Ali during his military expeditions according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal* highlights the unique spiritual status of Imam Ali (peace be upon him) by describing the celestial escort that accompanied him during military expeditions, symbolizing divine favor and protection. The presence of Gabriel and Michael flanking him, along with the Angel of Death and a shading cloud, underscores the concept of *Tawfiq* (divine success) and the cosmic significance of his leadership in Shia tradition.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-42 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted Muhammad ibn al-Hussein ibn Abil Khat’tab, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Sin’an, on the authority of Al-Mufaz’zal ibn Umar, on the authority of Jabir ibn Yazid al-Jo’afy, on the authority of Abil Zubayr (Muhammad ibn Muslim ibn Tadras Al-Asady) al-Macci, on the authority of Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari that God’s Prophet (MGB) said,

“I swear by Him in whose Hands is my soul that whenever I sent Ali to a battle I saw Gabriel along with seventy-thousand angels on his right side and Michael with seventy-thousand angels on his left side. I also saw that the angel of death (Israel) was in front of him and there was a cloud shadowing over his head all the way until he became victorious.”
